units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:15">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>ומי סלקא ט׳ בנורא</he> is the law requiring immersion (for levitical purification) complied with by putting the object in fire? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>עיקר ט׳ וכ׳</he> the true purification is by fire (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 31:23">Num. XXXI, 23</cite>).
